_about: Hand-assigned ground truth for triage evaluation. 'yes' means the paper reports one or more specific COL4A1/COL4A2 variants carried by specific individuals, whether or not the variants appear in the text we can download (supplement-only papers are still yes). Assigned 2026-10-29 by reading all 20 extraction outputs for the data/raw/2026-10-29 window.
